summary: First full run of HireMyFace. Backend: 26/26 pytest checks pass (auth 401/403, profiles, creator approval, free 2-offer limit returning 402, test-mode Pro upgrade, counter/accept/pay/submit/deliver/release/rate lifecycle, chat masking before and after payment, notifications read, cross-user deal returns 404). Frontend (Playwright, 390px mobile + 1920 desktop): landing, signed-out redirect to /sign-in, Clerk ticket sign-in, refresh keeps session, discover grid of 8 samples, category chips/city select/sort/filter sheet, + FAB role chooser, 2-step business setup, 3-step creator setup (pending), admin approval, creator profile tabs/highlights/save, offer dialog, 3rd offer blocked with toast, chat locked then Upgrade test payment then chat works, masking in UI, full two-sided deal flow in UI including admin release and rating shown on profile, notifications, profile switch mode/UPI save/logout, member redirected away from /app/admin. All core flows work. Found 1 HIGH backend payment bug (from code review, confirmed by reading the code but not run end-to-end) plus a few minor issues.

critical.issue: You can create several payment orders for the same deal while it is 'accepted', and verify only checks payment.status. Verifying a second or stale payment later runs mark_payment_done again. That sets deal.status back to 'paid' and payout_status to 'held' even if the deal is already delivered or completed, and records a double charge. Verify also never checks that the deal is still 'accepted', so a deal cancelled after its order was created can still be marked paid. Fix: in verify, for kind=deal, require deal.status=='accepted' (or do an atomic find_one_and_update on {id, status:'accepted'}). Reuse or reject an existing open order for the same deal. Make the payment status change atomic (update_one({id, status:{$ne:'paid'}})) so two verifies at the same time can't extend Pro twice.

minor.issue: The phone pattern also matches ISO dates: 'Shoot on 2026-12-20' becomes 'Shoot on [hidden until payment]'. Dates are normal deal talk, so this is a false positive. Require 10+ digits, or exclude the YYYY-MM-DD pattern.
Declined and cancelled offers still count toward the 2 free offers a month. This may be intended; please confirm.
Editing an approved profile keeps status 'approved', so name and photo changes skip admin moderation.
Doesn't check that the creator exists. Any string can be saved.
Leaves deals, messages and payments behind, still pointing at the deleted user and creator.
Samples show e.g. '4.5★ 3 reviews' and 'Jobs done 2', but the Reviews tab says 'No reviews yet'. Inconsistent.

integration_issues.issue: profile-logout-button sends the user to /sign-in instead of the landing page '/'. The Protected route redirect fires before afterSignOutUrl. Still a signed-out UI, so minor.

issues: The start date uses the browser's native <input type=date> instead of a shadcn Calendar/Popover date picker.
Counter and submit-work actions show a generic 'Updated' toast. Use specific messages like 'Counter-offer sent' or 'Work submitted'.
The subtitle shows 'no role yet' (meaning active_mode is null) right next to the role select showing 'admin' or 'member'. Confusing; rename it to something like 'no profile yet'.
The header stats show reviews, but the Reviews tab is empty for samples.

action_items: HIGH: Harden the deal payment verify path: check that the deal is still 'accepted', block or reuse duplicate orders for the same deal, and make the paid transition atomic.
Make the contact-mask regex stop masking dates (YYYY-MM-DD).
Optional: send approved creator profile edits back for re-review; validate creator_id in POST /saved; clean up related data in DELETE /me.
Replace the native date input in OfferDialog with the shadcn Calendar.
Use specific toast text for deal actions; fix the 'no role yet' label in the admin users list; make logout land on '/'.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 701 lines, at the 700-line limit. Split it into routers (deals, payments, admin, profiles).
mark_payment_done reads then writes without a condition, so concurrent verifies race and can extend Pro twice.

Payout math is correct: 10% fee, a ₹2,600 deal releases ₹2,340. Admin endpoints are correctly gated by require_role('admin'). _id is excluded everywhere checked. The creator's phone is stripped from public creator endpoints.

success_rate.backend: 100% (26/26 tests; 1 HIGH bug found by code review)
success_rate.frontend: ~97% (all requested flows passed; minor UX issues only)

test_credentials: Used admin/brand/creator +clerk_test users from /app/memory/test_credentials.md through Clerk sign-in tickets (UI) and session JWTs (API). All 3 users still exist.
seed_data_creation: Brand user has business 'TEST_Chai Point Cafe' and Business Pro active (test payment). Creator user has approved creator profile 'TEST_Meera Creator' (rating 4.0 from the UI flow) with UPI meera2@upi. One completed UI deal between them. Removed the temporary 'TEST_Creator Biz' business. The pytest module fixture resets the brand's deals and Pro status and the creator's profile on each run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run the backend suite serially: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_hiremyface_api.py -n 0. pytest.ini forces xdist -n 2, which breaks the ordered stateful flow. Get tokens with: python tests/clerk_helper.py ticket <admin|brand|creator>, which writes /tmp/ticket_<who>; the browser script reads that file and opens /sign-in?__clerk_ticket=... Tickets are single-use, so mint a new one for every browser run. In extra browser contexts, save screenshots as .jpeg (png + quality errors). ChipSelect testids slugify the label: '₹5k–20k' becomes 'business-budget--5k-20k'. Retest the payment verify hardening once it is fixed.
